sv.title: Demonstrationer i Turkiet när klimatmötet når halvtid
sv.summary: Vid FN:s pågående klimatkonferens COP31 i Turkiet hålls demonstrationer i dag. Ekots klimatreporter Mona Hambraeus på plats i Antalya rapporterar om en blandad skara demonstranter .”Folkets marsch för klimatet går av stapeln nu, som arrangeras av bland annat Greenpeace”, säger hon.

en.title: Demonstrations in Turkey as climate summit reaches halfway
en.summary: Demonstrations are being held today at the UN's ongoing climate conference COP31 in Turkey. Ekot's climate reporter Mona Hambraeus, on the spot in Antalya, reports on a mixed crowd of demonstrators. 'The people's march for the climate is under way now, organised by Greenpeace among others,' she says.
